long_biography.plain_text:
Nikolaos Gerolymatos joined a family enterprise whose origins lie in his grandfather's Athens pharmacy and whose scale was built by his father, Panagiotis. After studying at Richmond American University London, he became part of the third generation responsible for the company's development. A sale of the Greek operations left its international business intact before he assumed leadership in 2009.

Gerolymatos reorganised the remaining group, strengthened foreign distribution and prepared a renewed domestic platform. The company returned to Greece with over-the-counter healthcare, optics and veterinary divisions, while expanding its own brands through acquisitions and export partnerships. He now serves as president and chief executive, combining ownership continuity with active management of a multinational health-products business.
